set.body:
Epic: bd-01M1Z987V50254M59P9MNGP9FH
Delivery phase: 3 of 6; child 5 of 12.
Design: docs/design/interaction.md; full snapshot retained in the epic note.
Status: planned work; no implementation or passing evidence is asserted.

Scope
Implement additive/subtractive lasso and rectangle selection; whole-scene magnification; data-window pan, wheel/pinch zoom, rectangle zoom, bounds, and reset. Define arbitration among brushing, panning, activation, and page scrolling.

Acceptance criteria
1. Click/lasso selection can accumulate, subtract, clear, and restore a basket using the documented picking predicates.
2. Pointer capture, cancellation, Escape, touch, and visible mode/reset controls behave consistently and do not leave stuck gestures.
3. Data-window navigation preserves trained scales and statistic results while updating panel ranges/axes; it reuses resolved statistics rather than rerunning the whole compiler.
4. Numeric, date, and UTC windows retain their scale kinds. Transformed coordinates require checked inverse capabilities and free facets remain independent by default.
5. Whole-scene magnification and analytical viewport navigation have distinct, documented label/mark sizing semantics.

Exclusions
Implicit data filtering or statistic recomputation on selection/zoom; those require explicit application actions.

Required evidence
Browser gesture traces on clipped/transformed/faceted scenes; independent expected selected keys; a counted statistic proves no recomputation during data-window navigation.
Retain tested source SHA, fixture inputs, expected outputs, and actual gate results. Pending or unavailable checks remain explicitly pending.

Prerequisites
bd-01M1Z9B1VT19HE55FNS365YVRJ

Coordination
Reserve only actual files when implementation starts. Parent containment is not a prerequisite on the epic; do not create a child-to-epic dependency cycle.
set.title: [Intaglio][Interaction 05] Add region selection and data-aware pan/zoom with touch and cancellation
